plugins.Author: Nexai
plugins.Name: FCCH
plugins.Punchline: Automate Free Company chest deposits, withdrawals, organization, and workshop material pulls.
plugins.Description: Free Company Chest Helper. Automate deposits, withdrawals, organization, crystals, workshop project pulls, and custom item lists.
plugins.Changelog:
Added: Info button in the settings title bar. Opens Changelog, Logs, and Credits.
Added: Logs tab shows recent FCCH activity. Copy, clear, or save it to a file.
Changed: Lock and Snap moved from the title bar to the General tab.
Changed: One chat line per batch, naming the items that did not fit.
Fixed: The gil preview no longer says "Not logged in." when you hold 0 gil.
Fixed: The move count no longer counts HQ items twice with Lower Quality on Deposit.
